meta.name: Apple Photos (iOS 26)
meta.source: Apple Photos on iPhone, iOS 26: library grid with glass tab capsule, single photo viewer, info panel, Memory pages, edit tools. Press screenshots (9to5Mac, AppleInsider, Tom's Guide) and Apple Support (reference/SOURCES.md).
meta.use: Second reference for Jotful, paired with apple-wallet-dna. Wallet governs the home stack and cards; Photos governs the detail view, media viewing, the info panel and the date scrubber.
not_copied: SF Symbols as Apple marks (use Lucide equivalents in mocks)

soul.one_line: Content edge to edge on a plain white page; every control floats above it as small separate glass islands, and details live in a sheet you pull up.
soul.lineage: iOS Photos since iOS 7; Liquid Glass controls (iOS 26).
soul.read_distance: 3 metres: a full-bleed image with round floating controls in the corners.

banned_behaviours: No coloured chrome; colour belongs to the content.
Blue only for a text link or the active tab, never a filled button in the viewer.

treatment.case: Sentence case; relative dates ('Yesterday', 'Today') as the viewer title, time beneath

space.viewer: media full width, centred vertically in the space between the top and bottom control rows; no side margin, no radius
space.title_capsule: ~38% of screen width, title semibold 17pt over time regular 13pt grey
space.grid: 3 columns edge to edge, ~2pt gutters, square crops
space.info_sheet: media slides up and shrinks to the top ~40%; white panel below with 16pt side margins, grouped rows in rounded cards (radius ~16)

surface.edges: media: square corners, full bleed. Controls: perfect circles and capsules. Info cards: ~16pt radius.
surface.glass: white Liquid Glass with a soft shadow; on dark content it reads as smoked glass
surface.elevation: only the glass controls float; nothing else has a shadow
surface.iconography: regular-weight line symbols, black on glass

signatures.how: Viewer top: back circle (left), a centred glass capsule with the relative date title and time under it, a More circle (right).
Viewer bottom: Share circle left, a centred capsule of 3 actions (Favourite, Info, Adjust), Delete circle right.
signatures.never: Never more than 3 in the centre capsule; destructive sits alone at the trailing edge.

signatures.how: The item fills the width with square corners; chrome never sits on a coloured band.
signatures.never: No card frame around the media in the viewer.

signatures.how: A thin row of tiny thumbnails above the bottom bar; the current item is ~1.5x wider and set apart by a small gap on each side; scrubbable.

Swipe up (or Info): media shrinks to the top, a white panel rises: one smart chip (Look Up …), two big grey pill buttons side by side, a caption field, then one grouped card of metadata with a blue 'Adjust' link, then a map.
signatures.never: Never metadata on top of the media.

signatures.move: One small chip on the content
signatures.how: A single context chip (Visual Look Up / Live Text) floats on the media's corner.
signatures.never: Never more than one chip on the media.

signatures.how: While scrolling a long timeline a thin handle appears on the edge; grab and drag to jump; a capsule bubble beside the thumb shows the month and year under the finger.
signatures.never: Never visible at rest; fades ~1s after the finger lifts.

weird_move.name: Floating islands, not bars
weird_move.what: Controls are split into separate glass shapes (circle, capsule, circle) with empty space between them, symmetric left/centre/right, floating over edge-to-edge content.
weird_move.rule: Every control row is exactly three islands: a single circle at each edge and one capsule in the middle.
weird_move.never: Never merge them into one bar; never put a label on the edge circles.

archetypes.anatomy: three-island top bar; media full width; optional chip on media; filmstrip; three-island bottom bar
media shrunk to top; smart chip; two big pill buttons; caption field; grouped metadata card with blue Adjust; map
edge-to-edge 3-col grid; floating glass tab capsule + separate search circle at the bottom; date scrubber while scrolling
big hero image with title over it, then grid

motion.viewer_open: zoom from the tapped thumbnail into place (shared element), spring ~0.35s, no bounce
motion.info: media and sheet move together on the same pan (velocity-driven)
motion.dismiss: drag down on media shrinks it back to its thumbnail
motion.scrubber: appears on scroll, selection haptic as the bubble's month changes (inferred)

bans: No full-width navigation or tool bars; three islands only.
No colour on chrome; colour lives in the content.
No borders or frames around the media in the viewer.
No more than 3 actions in a centre capsule; Delete alone at the trailing edge.
No metadata over the media; it lives in the pull-up info panel.
No shadows except on floating glass controls.

tests.check: Top and bottom control rows are each exactly three islands (circle, capsule, circle).
Media spans the full screen width with square corners in the viewer.
Controls are 44pt circles/capsules, inset ~16pt, white glass with soft shadow.
Viewer title is a relative date with the time beneath, in the centre capsule.
Centre capsule holds ≤3 actions; the destructive action is alone at the trailing edge.
Colour outside the content covers under 2% (blue link/active tab only).
Info panel order: chip, two pill buttons, caption, grouped metadata card, map/extra.
No more than 3 type sizes in a frame.
Scrubber is hidden at rest and shows a month-year bubble while dragging.
Blind side-by-side with reference/viewer-2.jpg: reads as Photos within 2 seconds.

gaps_found: Round 1 (2026-10-18): reads as Photos at a glance (islands, full-bleed photo, filmstrip, chip). Gap: the title capsule is wider in Photos (~38% of screen width) with a semibold 17pt title and regular 13pt time; the rebuild's was narrow and bold. Added to space.title_capsule.
Round 1: in the filmstrip the current item sits apart with a small gap on each side and is ~1.5x wider; the rebuild made all thumbs equal. Added to the filmstrip signature.

uncertain: Date scrubber look and haptics: no screenshot found; built from forum descriptions and memory. Verify on the user's phone.
Grey card colour, text greys and blue are system defaults, not sampled.
